column1: # Polly's words for the screen reader (fm1-reader): the screen's text <TAB> what to say. "#" a number, "*" a word
# left out. tools/gen_words.py makes web/words/<id>.json (published with the site) and the link the FM-1 sends.
# Change a line and a new file is made: keep the old ones (devices in the wild point at them).
# Chord and note names are put in words by the firmware (ui.c speak): "Bb" here would also be "BB", "Ab" "AB".
